rows.grounds: compound amaṅgalya-upavāsin, one who observes an inauspicious fast
predicate describing the state attained in rebirth

items.question: What rebirth outcome follows from observing an inauspicious fast?
premises: Fasting practices produce specific fruits for the observer.
An inauspicious fast is performed by the subject.
Rebirth brings a transformed auspicious condition.
items.inference: One who observes an inauspicious fast becomes very auspicious in the next birth.
uncertainties: The exact gender of amaṃgalyopavāsī is contextually inferred as feminine from sumaṃgalī.
items.plain_english: And one who observes an inauspicious fast becomes very auspicious in the next birth.
